## Reviews
- Code review passed: one compiler model owns the facts, revision caching is shared, and all
  readers use the stable identity. No correctness finding remained open.
- Security review passed: indexing is read-only over graph-tracked source, does not execute or
  emit repository code, adds no write endpoint, and the dependency audit is clean.
- Simplification review passed: the dead JavaScript regex declaration scanner and unused compiler
  context were removed; migration-only payload fields remain isolated and documented.

## Deviations from plan
- `graph.ts`, `graph.test.ts`, `roles.ts`, and `roles.test.ts` did not need changes. Their existing
  tracked-file, import-edge, entry, generated, test, and fixture facts were sufficient inputs to
  the semantic index; code-role derivation lives with reachability instead.
- The local full-suite proof uses `TZ=UTC` because a pre-existing date-boundary test rolls over at
  20:00 America/New_York. The issue was captured separately rather than mixed into this task.

## Discovered issues
- `local-date-task-age-rolls-over-early`: task age treats a local calendar date as UTC and can
  report one day early in evening local time. It is recorded in intake.

## Open risks
- Dynamic imports, reflection, framework string registration, structural dispatch, and unsupported
  languages can hide callers or reachability. Every result carries this limitation and no deletion
  claim; users would notice unresolved findings or a role's unexpectedly sparse root set.
- Existing UI and CLI readers still display the legacy payload beside the richer model until the
  later Data Flow task migrates them. The structured argument remains authoritative and the legacy
  field is explicitly marked migration-only.
